_about: How federal funding calls are found on Grants.gov. Every keyword is searched among posted and forecasted opportunities; the combined results are then filtered by title. A call is kept when its title has an education term AND (a STEM+ term OR it comes from a STEM agency), unless it matches a drop pattern or comes from a dropped agency. Titles matching 'always' are kept regardless. Patterns are Python regular expressions, case-insensitive unless written as (?-i:...). agencies: display names by agency-code prefix (longest prefix wins).
